editorial:
If you thought John Wick was done after breaking the rules, think again. In this third chapter, the world's deadliest hitman is on the run with a huge price on his head. Every killer in the city wants him gone, and the High Table is pulling all the strings. Keanu Reeves is back, and he brings that same quiet, intense energy you love. The world feels bigger this time, with new faces like Halle Berry joining the fight. The vibe is pure chaos and nonstop action from the very first minute.

The action scenes are the real star here. From horseback chases to knife fights in antique shops, every scene feels fresh and exciting. The pacing never slows down, which is great if you want thrills but might feel exhausting if you need a break. The story is simple, so don't expect deep drama. If you love action movies, this is a must-watch.
endingExplained: After making a deal with the Bowery King, John Wick teams up to fight the High Table. The movie ends with him wounded but alive, ready for war. It's a cliffhanger setting up the next chapter. You see he is no longer running alone. He has allies now and a new mission ahead. The final shot shows him and the Bowery King planning their next move.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-energy action and stylish fight scenes.
